historyP1: Eeengenharia was born from the belief that building well is more than following blueprints — it's understanding what each client wants to leave behind.
historyP2: Specialised in LSF construction and renovation, we operate in residential, commercial and industrial projects with our own technical team and strategic partnerships that ensure rigour at every stage.
historyP3: From the first sketch to handing over the keys, we follow every build with the same attention to detail — because we know the result will last decades.

faqSubtitle: Have questions about our services? Find the most common answers here.
faqA1: LSF (Light Steel Framing) is a construction system that uses galvanised light steel profiles as its structure. It is faster to assemble, lighter and offers excellent thermal and acoustic performance compared to traditional construction.
faqQ2: How long does it take to build an LSF home?
faqA2: The timeframe varies depending on the size and complexity of the project, but on average an LSF home takes between 6 to 10 months, including foundations, structure and finishes.
faqQ3: Do you handle projects and licensing?
faqA3: Yes. We develop the architectural and engineering project and manage the entire licensing process with local councils and other authorities, from start to finish.
faqA4: Yes, we operate throughout mainland Portugal. Contact us to check availability for your region.
faqQ5: How can I get a quote?
faqA5: You can request a quote via the contact form, by email or by phone. We respond within 24 business hours with a preliminary proposal.
faqA6: Yes, preparing quotes is completely free and without obligation.
faqA7: All work is carried out with certified materials and in accordance with current regulations. We offer a post-construction warranty and technical follow-up after delivery.
